The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (January 25, 2024) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Doc4098286599 Description: For the supply and delivery of one (1) latest model trailer mounted gas engine drum type brush chipper with 12.5 inches (31.8 centimeters) chipping capacity, with option to purchase additional three (3) units in 2024, four (4) units in 2025, four (4) units in 2026, five (5) units in 2027, and three (3) units in 2028, pending budget availability. Upon Award of this Request for Quotation, the Supplier and the City will have a Contract from the date of award to December 31, 2028, for a fixed term of five (5) years, all in accordance with the terms, conditions, and specifications contained in this Request…
